info.title: job-ad service
info.description: Drafts and scores job advertisements. Headless: clients produce a HiringBrief, the service returns an ad and its scorecard.

get.description: Publishing channels the service can prepare payloads for, with their formats, limits (hard vs recommended) and required extras.

schema.title: Response List Platforms V1 Platforms Get

post.description: Free and deterministic: normalised fields, renderings (html, text, markdown, JSON-LD, teaser) and a per-platform payload with validation issues.
Free-text role description → HiringBrief (verbatim, nothing invented) + what is missing + questions to ask. One cheap model call.
Free, instant: which metrics this brief can satisfy, the composite ceiling, and which fields to add first. Call it before paying for a draft.

200.description: JSON by default; `?format=markdown` returns only the rendered ad as text/markdown (headers carry x-request-id and x-composite).

post.description: Asynchronous drafting: returns 202 with a job id immediately; poll status_url (or receive callback_url) for the /v1/drafts response.
Synchronous ranking for small pools (one judge call per candidate with free text, ~3–8 s each). Pools over 10 should use /v1/shortlist-jobs.
Asynchronous ranking: 202 with a job id; poll status_url (or receive callback_url) for the RankResult.
Statutory check of the terms (BCEA s29 particulars, NMW, hours, leave, notice, LRA s198B) and consistency with the ad's brief. Free, no model call; nothing is gated.

Offer letter + contract from the clause library with identity placeholders, plain-language explanation per clause, compliance report. Free, no model call. Template wording pending practitioner review.

200.description: JSON by default; `?format=markdown` returns the contract alone as text/markdown (header x-compliance-level).

cv_text.title: Cv Text
cv_text.description: plain text; identifiers are redacted before any model sees it

points.title: Points
points.description: set when the test runner graded the item (deterministic)

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: with rubric and no points: graded by the judge against the rubric

assessment_id.title: Assessment Id
assessment_id.description: the reusable test's id and version

time_used_s.title: Time Used S
time_used_s.description: reported to the recruiter, never scored

max_points.title: Max Points
max_points.description: optional; the sum of item max_points is authoritative

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: integrity signals from the test runner; shown, never scored

candidate_id.title: Candidate Id
candidate_id.description: the frontend's id; the only identifier the service keeps

declared.title: Declared
declared.description: yes/no or short facts the form asked directly; matched to knockouts/facts without a model

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: Flesch-Kincaid grade of the clause text

website.title: Website
website.description: Employer website; when set, web enrichment is restricted to this domain

would_be_not_ready.title: Would Be Not Ready
would_be_not_ready.description: True if the draft would come back 'not_ready' with must-fix reasons (no duties or requirements, or a designated employer without an EE statement)

unattainable_metrics.title: Unattainable Metrics
unattainable_metrics.description: metrics that must score 0 because the brief lacks their facts

estimated_ceiling.title: Estimated Ceiling
estimated_ceiling.description: approximate maximum composite this brief can reach (0–100)

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: fields to add, highest estimated lift first

result.title: Result
result.description: The /v1/drafts response once status is done

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: If set, the service POSTs {job_id, status, result, error} here when the job finishes (best effort).

allow_not_ready.title: Allow Not Ready
allow_not_ready.description: If false (default) and the completeness check says the draft would come back not_ready, the service refuses with 422 before any model call.

enrich.title: Enrich
enrich.description: Web enrichment: search the employer's public web presence (restricted to company.website when given) for about/values/locations/published benefits; cited in `sources`. Never pay or legal statements. Adds one model call and up to `max_searches` web searches.

ad.description: The structured ad: the source of truth. Score, edit and publish from this.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Web-sourced employer facts the drafter was allowed to use, by URL. Show them for the recruiter to confirm.

address.title: Address
address.description: registered/physical address — BCEA s29(1)(a) particular; distinct from place of work

description.title: Description
description.description: The role in the author's own words: duties, requirements, pay, team, process, anything they know

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: Usually known to the client; overrides anything the text says

brief.description: A valid brief, ready for /v1/drafts — or null when required fields are missing

brief_partial.title: Brief Partial
brief_partial.description: Everything extracted, in HiringBrief shape, even when incomplete; pre-fill the form with it

missing_required.title: Missing Required
missing_required.description: Required fields the description did not supply (title, company.name, responsibilities, must_have)

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Up to five questions to ask the author for the most valuable missing facts

completeness.description: The /v1/briefs/check result for the extracted brief, when it is valid

requirement.title: Requirement
requirement.description: exact text of a brief.must_have or brief.nice_to_have

FactLink.title: FactLink
FactLink.description: Lets a must-have / nice-to-have be decided from a declared fact instead of the judge.

redaction_clean.title: Redaction Clean
redaction_clean.description: no identifier pattern survived redaction in any text a model saw

note.title: Note
note.default: protected attributes have no field in the contract; free text is redacted before any model call; time is not scored

estimated_lift.title: Estimated Lift
estimated_lift.description: approximate composite points if the metrics it feeds reached full score

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Act section and the figure used

justification.title: Justification
justification.description: LRA s198B(3)-(4) reason; required when the term exceeds 3 months and pay is below the earnings threshold

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: At least one duty; the drafter rewrites, it does not add duties

JobAd.title: JobAd
JobAd.description: Structured job ad. Both the drafter's output and the benchmark's normalised form of real ads.

knockouts.title: Knockouts
knockouts.description: legally inherent requirements; failing one → tier does_not_meet_inherent_requirement (still listed)

declared_key.title: Declared Key
declared_key.description: when set, decided from candidate.declared[declared_key] == required_value; else judged from the application

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: a single stated period; must be at least the s37 floor for the longest service band

statutory_ladder.title: Statutory Ladder
statutory_ladder.description: true = the contract states the s37 ladder (1/2/4 weeks by service) instead of one figure

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Template generated from the agreed terms and checked against the BCEA, NMW Act and LRA rules in compliance-rules.yaml v0.1.0. Not legal advice; the clause library must be reviewed by a labour practitioner before use, and figures marked 'verify' confirmed against the Government Gazette.

value_zar.title: Value Zar
value_zar.description: BCEA s29(1)(j): the value must be stated

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: publish extras the client must supply, e.g. category, apply_url

word_band.title: Word Band
word_band.description: recommended description length in words (matches the scorer's channel override)

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: your job reference / external id, for updates and withdrawals

category.title: Category
category.description: platform category / sector / industry (SA boards require one)

employment_type.title: Employment Type
employment_type.description: permanent | fixed_term | contract | part_time | internship | learnership | temporary

valid_through.title: Valid Through
valid_through.description: defaults to the ad's closing date when parseable

PublishExtras.title: PublishExtras
PublishExtras.description: What the client knows that the ad text does not: where applications go, identifiers, taxonomy.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: false = deterministic only (declared facts + graded items); free, judged items left ungraded

explain_all.title: Explain All
explain_all.description: false keeps reasons only for the top_n

require_assessment.title: Require Assessment
require_assessment.description: candidates without an assessment are listed in excluded_from_ranking

borderline.title: Borderline
borderline.description: score lies within the noise band of a tier threshold; the tier could read one step either way on a re-run

extras.description: What the ad text does not carry: apply_url, reference, category, employment_type, company_url, dates

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Platform ids from GET /v1/platforms; default = all

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: The ad as Markdown — headings, bullets, bold. Deterministic from `ad`; convert to HTML or paste into an editor.

text.title: Text
text.description: The ad as plain text, as a candidate would read it

ScoringContext.title: ScoringContext
ScoringContext.description: Facts about the employer and publication the scorer needs (not the ad text).

earnings_threshold_override.title: Earnings Threshold Override
earnings_threshold_override.description: true = treat as above the BCEA s6(3) threshold regardless of pay

prior_service.title: Prior Service
prior_service.description: BCEA s29(1)(p): previous employment that counts towards service, if any

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: BCEA s29(1)(q): other documents forming part of the contract

employee_is_15_or_older.title: Employee Is 15 Or Older
employee_is_15_or_older.description: BCEA s43 attestation by the client; no age or date of birth is accepted

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: e.g. basic salary; cost to company

overtime_rate.title: Overtime Rate
overtime_rate.description: multiple of the hourly wage; BCEA s10(2) floor 1.5
